props.label: Responsive tips
tips: Shown in a popover above that breakpoint.

controlled.message: The playground wraps Passphrase with local state so typing updates value through an inline onChange handler.

confirmation.message: confirmation changes the default label to Confirm Passphrase and marks this field as the confirmation input.

tips.message: tips renders the info icon and displays each string as guidance for the passphrase.

responsive_tips.message: showTipsBelow controls when tips move below the input instead of appearing in the popover.

input_props.message: inputProps are passed through to the inner TextInput for id, name, placeholder, disabled, and similar input-level options.

uncontrolled.message: uncontrolled lets Passphrase manage the typed value internally instead of relying on the value prop.
